name: Elena Rodriguez
bio:
Elena Rodriguez's journey into motorsport began in her father's small auto repair shop in Buenos Aires. Growing up surrounded by engines and tools, she developed an innate understanding of mechanical systems. After earning her degree in Mechanical Engineering from the Universidad de Buenos Aires, Elena transitioned into the world of racing. She started as an apprentice machinist for a local touring car team, quickly proving her talent and dedication. 

Elena's meticulous approach to her work has earned her a reputation for producing high-quality components. She is known for her ability to diagnose and solve complex mechanical problems quickly and efficiently. Her calm demeanor and collaborative spirit make her a valuable asset to any team. She has a talent for mentoring younger mechanics, always willing to share her knowledge and experience. 

Her dedication and loyalty to her team is what sets her apart. Elena is always willing to go the extra mile to ensure that the car is ready to race. She sees her role as more than just a job; it's a passion that fuels her every day.

physical.hairStyle: Shoulder-length, usually pulled back in a practical ponytail.
physical.description: A strong and determined woman of medium build with a focused gaze.

quirks: Always sharpens her pencils to a perfect point before starting any task.
Has a collection of vintage motorsport posters that she displays in her workspace.
Sips mate tea constantly throughout the day from a traditional gourd.
